primaryChecks.previousContext: Rehoboam lived in Jerusalem, and built cities for defense in Judah.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 本文にテコアが町の名として明記され、防備都市一覧に含まれる。

primaryChecks.text: They rose early in the morning and went out into the wilderness of Tekoa. As they went out, Jehoshaphat stood and said, “Listen to me, Judah and you inhabitants of Jerusalem! Believe in the LORD your God, so you will be established! Believe his prophets, so you will prosper.”
primaryChecks.previousContext: The Levites, of the children of the Kohathites and of the children of the Korahites, stood up to praise the LORD, the God of Israel, with an exceedingly loud voice.
primaryChecks.nextContext: When he had taken counsel with the people, he appointed those who were to sing to the LORD and give praise in holy array as they go out before the army, and say, “Give thanks to the LORD, for his loving kindness endures forever.”
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 「テコアの荒野」は同じ地名に由来する周辺地域の表現として関係する。町そのものと荒野を同じ地理対象にしない。
